falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the 73% bottom pattern match, as that structure required a higher low formation; this would confirm continuation lower not bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 28.6 and rapidly declining; sustained elevated fear above 35 indicates a different regime (capitulation/escalation) versus the controlled bottoming pattern currently matched

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -50bps (more negative than -0.50%)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with curve steepening (disinversion); deepening inversion signals recession acceleration that would override the bullish bottom pattern and validate defensive positioning

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
